description: Central Mecanizada de Triagem de Resíduos Sólidos is a dataset listed in City of São Paulo open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by AMLURB - Autoridade Municipal de Limpeza Urbana (INATIVO). As centrais mecanizadas de triagem possuem capacidade individual para processar 250 toneladas diárias de resíduos. Esse tipo de equipamento, munido de leitores óticos, separam os materiais por tipo e cor. Tais centrais apresentam, ainda, esteiras automatizadas e um dispositivo chamado Trommel, que executa a separação dos resíduos por dimensão. Coverage: São Paulo. The portal files it under the publisher AMLURB - Autoridade Municipal de Limpeza Urbana (INATIVO). Its tags are Meio-Ambiente, Resíduos Sólidos, Triagem de Resíduos. It offers 5 resource(s) in CSV, SHP, XLS. The portal shows 2019-02-20 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-spcity-portal.
